pain_points.statement: Finance is three weeks behind on invoicing due to mismatched data across systems.

pain_points.statement: The driver mobile app lacks necessary features, forcing drivers to call dispatchers.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers must act as the integration layer across three disconnected systems.

desired_state.contradiction_note: The VP of Operations wants incremental change due to timeline constraints, but the CTO has been pushing for a full rebuild of the dispatch tool for a year.
